title: BMI Toolkit
prompt: Implement `double bmi(double weight_kg, double height_m)` = weight / (height*height), and `const char* bmi_band(double b)`: <18.5 -> "under", <25 -> "normal", <30 -> "over", else "obese".

tests.name: bands
tests.hint: Band edges: 18.5, 25, 30 — each boundary belongs to the band above it.

tests.name: band edges
tests.hint: The comparison is strict < on each threshold.
